newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Horse racing-Irish jockey remains seriously ill.
newsitem.headline: Horse racing-Irish jockey remains seriously ill.

text.p: Irish jockey Shane Broderick, who took a heavy fall when riding at Fairyhouse last week, remains seriously ill in a Dublin hospital, Ireland's Turf Club said in a statement on Monday.

"Shane Broderick's condition remains unchanged. Arrangements are being made for his transfer from the Mater Hospital to the National Rehabilitation Hospital, Dun Laoghaire (County Dublin) for further treatment," the statement said.
Broderick, 22, was taken unconscious to hospital after a fall at the County Meath racecourse last Monday. He was later transferred to intensive care, reportedly with spinal injuries.
